title: The Ant Lion
text: The sand gives way without a sound and slides, and slides, into a funnel as wide as a field. Bones ring the slope, picked clean and polished. At the bottom, a pair of mandibles opens and waits.

outcomes.text: Out, gasping, sand in everything, the mandibles clicking far below.
It flicks sand up the slope, and you slide, and slide, down toward it.

options.label: The strongest hauls everyone out on a rope.

outcomes.text: One by one, arms shaking, and the mandibles snap shut on nothing.

options.label: Go down into the funnel and kill it.

outcomes.text: It fights from the bottom of its pit, and when it dies its shell is worth something.
